card.line: Paddan-aram was the region around Haran, home of Rebekah's family, where Jacob went to find a wife and where his sons were born.

moments.title: Isaac marries Rebekah
moments.text: Isaac was forty years old when he married Rebekah. She was the daughter of Bethuel the Aramean from Paddan-aram and the sister of Laban.

moments.title: Jacob is sent to find a wife
moments.text: Isaac told Jacob not to marry a Canaanite woman. He sent Jacob to Paddan-aram to take a wife from the daughters of Laban, and he asked God Almighty to bless Jacob.

moments.title: Jacob's sons are born
moments.text: Jacob had twelve sons. The sons of Leah, Rachel, Bilhah, and Zilpah were born to him in Paddan-aram.

moments.title: Jacob leaves with his family
moments.text: Jacob put his children and wives on camels and drove his livestock ahead of him. He took all the possessions he had gained in Paddan-aram and set out for his father Isaac in Canaan.

moments.title: God blesses Jacob again
moments.text: After Jacob returned from Paddan-aram, God appeared to him and blessed him. God changed his name to Israel and promised him land and many descendants.
